studies.title: From recording to editable workflow
studies.thesis: A recording becomes trustworthy only after the system exposes its structure.

states.label: Capture
states.headline: Three actions, one recording
states.detail: The system observes a search, a field entry, and a final review step.

states.label: Structure
states.headline: Intent replaces coordinates
states.detail: Recorded actions become named steps with stable inputs and outputs.

states.label: Inspect
states.headline: The user edits what matters
states.detail: Variables, permissions, and the final approval boundary become inspectable.

states.label: Ready
states.headline: Validated before execution
states.detail: The workflow can run only after required fields and authority checks pass.

studies.reducedMotion: Show the same four states as immediate cuts with the state label and causal explanation preserved.

studies.title: From failure to accountable recovery
studies.thesis: A useful failure state explains what stopped, who decides, and how the run resumes.

states.label: Running
states.headline: The run advances normally
states.detail: Read-only collection and validation complete inside the approved policy.

states.label: Blocked
states.headline: The write step fails closed
states.detail: A changed record invalidates the prepared action before any mutation occurs.

states.label: Review
states.headline: The decision moves to an owner
states.detail: The reviewer sees the diff, the reason for escalation, and the recovery options.

states.label: Resumed
states.headline: Approval binds to the new state
states.detail: The run resumes from the blocked step and records the decision in the trace.

studies.reducedMotion: Replace pulse and travel with immediate semantic state changes, persistent status text, and a complete audit trace.

studies.title: One product system, interface-native surfaces
studies.thesis: Shared product truth should travel across surfaces without forcing the same interaction everywhere.

states.label: Shared record
states.headline: One normalized product object
states.detail: Source, role, company, match rationale, and freshness form the shared contract.

states.label: Web
states.headline: Web supports comparison
states.detail: A wider surface prioritizes scanning, filtering, and side-by-side evidence.

states.label: macOS
states.headline: Desktop supports repeated action
states.detail: Keyboard navigation and compact state make the operating loop faster.

states.label: Mobile
states.headline: Mobile supports triage
states.detail: The same record compresses to the decision needed while away from a desk.

states.label: CLI + MCP
states.headline: Agents receive structured truth
states.detail: The interface becomes a typed response with provenance, not a screenshot of the UI.

studies.reducedMotion: Reveal each surface as a static comparison while preserving the shared record fields and surface-specific interaction decision.
